testo: ■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may take a Jokers from among them and put it into your hand. Then put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
testo_jp: ■ このクリーチャーがバトルゾーンに出た時、自分の山札の上から4枚を見る。その中からジョーカーズを1枚選び、手札に加えてもよい。残りを好きな順序で山札の一番下に置く。
